💡 Backbone Pro M1 & M2 Notice:

On Backbone Pro, rear buttons M1 (Right) and M2 (Left) are unassigned by default in hardware firmware:

1. Open the Backbone App on your phone
2. Settings ⚙️ > Controller > Controller Profiles > Button Assignments
3. Map M1 (Right) → A (Jump)
4. Map M2 (Left) → LB or L3 (Sprint)

Saved directly to controller memory & works immediately!

⌨️ Keyboard & Mouse

WASD
Move Character8-directional ground navigation
Mouse
Aim CursorDirects throw arc, target highlight & facing direction
Space
Jump / ClimbJump, scale walls, or steer toward ground to dismount
E
Pick Up / SwapGrabs target; if holding, swaps with targeted ground item
Q
Drop ItemDrops held item onto the ground
L-Click
Throw / GrabThrows held item; grabs reachable object if empty-handed
R-Click
Lock AimSnaps aim cursor directly to closest reachable target
Shift
Sprint1.55x speed boost; auto-resets when releasing movement

🎮 Controller / Gamepad

LS
Left JoystickAnalog 360° proportional character movement
RS
Virtual Aim CursorFree-floating cursor across arena; guides throw target
A / M1
Jump / ClimbJump, scale walls, or dismount into arena (Right Paddle M1)
B
Pick Up / SwapGrabs target; if holding, swaps with targeted ground item
Y
Drop ItemDrops held item onto the ground
RT / RB
Throw / GrabRT throws held item (or grabs); RB is dedicated instant throw
LT
Lock AimSnaps aim reticle directly to closest reachable target
LB / M2
SprintHold or tap bumper / paddle (M2) for 1.55x sprint speed
💡 Pro-Tip: While holding an object, your creature dynamically aims toward your cursor and highlights reachable ground items in your player color. Press E (Keyboard) or B (Gamepad) to instantly swap items!
